_leeme: The public build (python3 armar.py --publico -> dist/publico/index.html). 'aviso' is what it says about itself; 'prohibido' is what the build refuses to publish: 'en_todo' words searched in the whole file, 'en_datos' patterns searched in the embedded data.

aviso.largo: Unofficial map, made by a community volunteer. Sizes and positions are approximate and the festival set-up can still change: the printed map is the official one.
aviso.creditos: Typefaces: Mozilla Headline, Mozilla Text and IBM Plex Mono, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. 3D: three.js, MIT licence.
